title: RNA Binding Mechanism of the FUS Zinc Finger in Concert with Its Flanking Intrinsically Disordered Region
one_liner_zh: 该文通过MD和并行级联选择模拟研究FUS锌指及其侧翼无序RGG2结构域与RNA的结合机制，虽聚焦RNA而非TF-DNA，但蛋白-核酸互作建模方法可迁移至TF-DNA研究。
abstract: The zinc finger (ZnF) motif is the most common nucleic acid binding motifs in proteins and comprises approximately 5% of the human genome. Proteins often carry multiple copies of ZnF motifs, enhancing DNA- and RNA-binding affinity and specificity. Fused in Sarcoma (FUS) is an RNA-binding protein that contains one ZnF motif and one RNA recognition motif. We identified the molecular basis for the strong and specific binding of FUS ZnF to RNA at atomic resolution by performing molecular dynamics and dissociation parallel cascade selection molecular dynamics simulations of a single-stranded RNA complexed with FUS ZnF and the flanking intrinsically disordered RGG2 domain, and observed dissociation of the complex. Our results suggest two distinct binding modes of the FUS ZnF-RNA complex. One is that ZnF specifically recognizes the GGU sequence of RNA while the RGG2 domain non-specifically interacts with RNA and distorts the RNA backbone structure. The second is that ZnF similarly recognizes the GGU of RNA specifically, but the RGG2 domain is barely involved in RNA binding, resulting in weaker binding. Further comprehensive analysis of nucleic acid binding site sequences indicates two possible mechanisms for ensuring strong and specific nucleic acid binding in nucleic acid binding proteins: the first is the stabilization of protein-RNA binding using only one or few nucleic acid binding motifs with flanking disordered regions as in the case of FUS ZnF, and the second is the involvement of more nucleic acid binding motifs. Our findings allow us to expand the repertoire of disordered region-assisted nucleic acid binding by ZnF from double-stranded DNAs to single-stranded RNAs.
abstract_zh: 锌指（ZnF）基序是蛋白质中最常见的核酸结合基序，约占人类基因组的5%。蛋白质通常携带多个ZnF基序拷贝，从而增强DNA和RNA的结合亲和力及特异性。融合肉瘤（FUS）是一种RNA结合蛋白，含有一个ZnF基序和一个RNA识别基序。我们通过分子动力学（molecular dynamics）和解离平行级联选择分子动力学模拟，对单链RNA与FUS ZnF及侧翼内在无序RGG2结构域的复合物进行了研究，并在原子分辨率下确定了FUS ZnF与RNA强特异性结合的分子基础，同时观察到了复合物的解离。我们的结果表明，FUS ZnF-RNA复合物存在两种不同的结合模式。一种模式是ZnF特异性识别RNA的GGU序列，而RGG2结构域非特异性地与RNA相互作用并使RNA骨架结构发生扭曲。第二种模式中，ZnF同样特异性识别RNA的GGU，但RGG2结构域几乎不参与RNA结合，导致结合较弱。对核酸结合位点序列的进一步综合分析表明，核酸结合蛋白确保强特异性核酸结合可能存在两种机制：第一种是仅利用一个或少数核酸结合基序及其侧翼无序区域来稳定蛋白质-RNA结合，如FUS ZnF的情况；第二种是涉及更多核酸结合基序。我们的发现使得无序区域辅助的ZnF核酸结合范围从双链DNA扩展到了单链RNA。
